tools.name: get_component_docs
tools.description: Get the API contract (properties, attributes, events, slots, CSS parts, CSS vars) for a Tyler Forge component. Call list_components first if you need to discover available components. For HTML usage code, call `get_forge_blocks` instead — blocks are the sole source of Forge markup.

component.description: Component tag name (e.g., "forge-button", "forge-card"). Required — call list_components first if you don't know the tag name.

sections.description: Optional: specific documentation sections to include. Only applies to full format.

format.description: Documentation format: full (default) or summary (brief overview). For HTML usage code, call `get_forge_blocks` — this tool returns API contract only.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: Browse all available Tyler Forge components with descriptions. Returns a comprehensive table of all components with their purpose and capabilities.

tools.name: find_components
tools.description: Search Tyler Forge components by name, description, or functionality with enhanced fuzzy matching. Supports multi-term queries like "app bar drawer". Returns all components when no query provided.

query.description: Search query to find components by name, description, or features. Leave empty to list all components.

searchIn.description: Optional: specify what to search in (default: all)

limit.description: Optional: maximum number of results to return (default: 10 for search, unlimited for list all)

matchAll.description: Optional: require all search terms to match (default: false - match any term)

includeRelated.description: Optional: include related components in results (default: false)

tools.name: validate_component_api
tools.description: Validate Tyler Forge component-specific API usage after code generation. Supports all components in @tylertech/forge. DO NOT use this tool to validate standard HTML attributes (id, class, style, etc.), ARIA attributes (aria-*), or data attributes (data-*) - these are valid on all elements. Only validate component-specific properties, attributes, events, methods, slots, CSS properties, parts, and classes.

apis.description: APIs to validate for the component

cssProperties.description: CSS custom property names to validate (e.g., ["--forge-button-background"])

tools.name: get_design_tokens
tools.description: Get Tyler Forge design tokens for consistent styling. Access color palettes, spacing scales, typography, animation, and other design system values.

category.description: Optional: specific design token category (default: all categories overview)

tools.name: setup_typography
tools.description: Access Tyler Forge typography setup instructions including font families, type scales, weights, and practical usage guidelines for consistent text styling.

tools.name: setup_icons
tools.description: Access Tyler Forge icons system including installation, registration, and usage patterns for the forge-icon component.

tools.name: find_icons
tools.description: Search Tyler Icons using semantic/fuzzy search with natural language queries. Finds the closest matching icons by name and keywords.

query.description: Space-separated search terms to find matching icons (e.g., "user profile", "arrow left", "check mark")

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

tools.name: get_usage_guide
tools.description: Get comprehensive Tyler Forge guides including installation instructions, framework-specific integration, and general usage patterns

type.description: Type of guide: general (default - usage patterns), installation (setup instructions), or framework (framework-specific integration)

framework.description: Framework for installation or framework guides. Required for type=framework.

tools.name: setup_framework
tools.description: Get complete framework-specific setup instructions for Tyler Forge components including installation, configuration, and best practices.

framework.description: Target framework for Tyler Forge setup and integration

tools.name: get_version_migration_guide
tools.description: Get comprehensive migration guides for upgrading between Tyler Forge versions, including breaking changes, API mappings, and upgrade instructions

tools.name: get_forge_blocks
tools.description: Get Forge UI code blocks - pre-built patterns and examples that demonstrate correct Forge component usage. Use this FIRST before generating any Forge UI code to ensure accurate patterns. Can list/search blocks or fetch specific block content.

query.description: Describe the UI functionality you need (e.g., "form with validation", "data table with sorting", "user profile card"). Searches block descriptions to find matching functionality. Results are ranked by relevance - top results may be usable directly, while lower-ranked results can serve as starting points.

blockId.description: Specific block ID to fetch the full HTML content for (e.g., "src/blocks/forms/login").

component.description: Filter blocks by Forge component usage. Returns all blocks that use the specified component (e.g., "forge-card", "forge-table", "forge-button"). Use this to see how a component is used across different contexts and patterns.

limit.description: Maximum number of blocks to return when listing (default: 20).

tools.name: generate_ui_plan
tools.description: Emit a machine-checkable UI plan (scaffold block, regions, typography roles, icons) before writing composition-scale Forge markup. Returns the empty plan template and the enums the plan must use. Call validate_ui_plan on the composed plan before writing any <forge-*> markup. See references/ui-plan.md.

description.description: What the user is asking you to build. A sentence or two is enough; the plan is composed from the description plus the current session context.

framework.description: Framework in use (angular, react, vue, svelte, lit, or plain). Optional — only affects framework-specific plan hints.

page_type_hint.description: Optional page type if the caller already knows it. Otherwise leave blank and pick during plan composition.

tools.name: validate_ui_plan
tools.description: Validate a UI plan produced by generate_ui_plan. Checks: page_type enum, region components exist in the CEM, block IDs exist in the block catalogue, typography roles are legal, spacing_scale is tokens-only, icons exist in @tylertech/tyler-icons, and composition rules (no page_title inside card, no hand-rolled tables). Returns pass/fail with per-error hints. Markup must not be written until this returns valid=true.

plan.description: The plan object emitted by generate_ui_plan, either as an object or a JSON string.
